approved_by.evidence: Explicit request to implement the next BH-03 phase section by section, merge one pull request, synchronize main, and delete the feature branch.

authorized_scope: Implement one exact-compatible shared runtime result per bounded host scope.
Coalesce concurrent startup and reuse the ready runtime without transferring release ownership to roots.
Implement independent root registration, mount, update, move, dispose, and remount queues.
Require root identifier and generation acknowledgements before state commits.
Reject duplicate roots, incompatible reuse, stale generations, foreign acknowledgements, and illegal transitions.
Publish versioned Phase 4 fixtures, validation, and completion evidence.
not_authorized: retry, restart, recovery, or fallback execution
browser-profile composition or active browser results
renderer, DOM interaction, component, Phoenix, Plug, or server command behavior
resource or reliability measurements and BH-03 acceptance
public API stability, package publication, or support claims
